brand.notes: Homage AC (brand of R&I Electrical Appliances Pvt Ltd, maker/distributor of Kenwood in Pakistan). Verified lines: Element (HES), eSmart/Smart Crystal (HCS/HSC), Classic, Smart Cool, Prestige (HPS), Grande (non-inverter). DOCUMENTED GAP as of 2026-09-23: no official Homage AC error-code table, no AC service manual with a fault chart, no retailer error-code page (AYS Homage docs URL is 404). 30+ searches yielded exactly one community-reported code (F1, low confidence, contested in-thread). Homage UPS fault codes exist but belong to a different product category and are excluded. See docs/sources/homage.md.
